question: 20261030-1250-research-data-apis-35cd-u04-q04: does the GDELT DOC 2.0 API serve any unaffiliated caller, measured as a share of calls over several days at spacings of 6 seconds or more?
why: On 2026-11-02 no call returned an article list: from one residential ISP address, 8 calls answered HTTP 429 and 3 calls, for two query URLs, answered HTTP 200 with a 2-byte {} body; 3 cloud fetch calls answered 429. The broker's read routes cannot carry this API: an unpinned read answers HTTP 415 not-html, and 7 provider-pinned reads answered HTTP 502 or 504 earlier in the day, so only the fetch route reached the origin. A third party reports 1 request of 7 getting through at 6-second spacing on 27 July 2026. A series of spaced calls over several days, at several times of day, settles the share.
